title: FREQUENCY on the cavern pick: the first four cavern species of CTRL's cavern pool (alphabetical) at 100/50/25/12, every other cavern species at 1, all cavern entries stocked 500; tool disarmed; the map released every 1,500 ticks (surface and caverns). Cavern wave shares vs f/sum(f).
fork: cavern shares proportional to FREQUENCY (as F1 on the surface) or not
kill_criterion: the order of cavern shares does not follow FREQUENCY
culling: drop a replicate on any breach or changed save

arms.name: cavern_f100_50_25_12
pre: local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local cfg=sw.loadConfig(); if not cfg.initialized then sw.captureDefault(cfg) end; cfg.enabled=false; cfg.groups.enabled=false; cfg.ecology.enabled=false; sw.saveConfig(cfg); sw.disableSched(); print('tool disarmed')

local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local rs=sw.getEmbarkRegions(); local cav={}; local ids={}; for _,pop in ipairs(df.global.world.populations.all) do if df.world_population_type[pop.type]=='Animal' and sw.managedPop(pop, rs, sw.LAYER_SET.cavern) then local cr=df.creature_raw.find(pop.race); if not cav[pop.race] then cav[pop.race]=true; ids[#ids+1]=cr.creature_id end; pop.quantity=500; pop.flags.extinct=false end end; table.sort(ids); local F={100,50,25,12}; local want={}; for i=1,math.min(4,#ids) do want[ids[i]]=F[i] end; local o=0; for i,cr in ipairs(df.global.world.raws.creatures.all) do if want[cr.creature_id] then cr.frequency=want[cr.creature_id] elseif cav[i] then cr.frequency=1; o=o+1 end end; local s={}; for k,v in pairs(want) do s[#s+1]=k..'='..v end; print('eco: cavern species '..#ids..'; set '..table.concat(s,' ')..'; '..o..' others at 1; all cavern entries stocked 500')
